_readme: Sources the news workflow may read. Only add a source if its owner offers an RSS/Atom feed or API for this use, and its terms allow showing headlines with links. We store ONLY headline, link, publication time and the feed's own category labels: never article text or images. 'enabled:false' sources are ignored.
